messages:
Maria (CS): heads-up — AirFrame (enterprise) flagged a new internal use case: real-time telemetry summarization at edge nodes. they want to roll it out to 4 additional engineering teams next q.
Sam (AE): nice, any sizing ask yet?
Maria (CS): not formal, but Product mentioned 2x the current token throughput during peak training+inference windows. likely need dedicated pods or burst capacity.
Priya (Solutions): can we get more color on latency SLOs? edge summarization usually wants <250ms p95.
Maria (CS): yes that's what they said in the call. they also said some teams will prefer our private deployment (VPC) for data residency.
Liam (Onboarding): timeline? onboarding for 4 teams + private setup could be ~6 weeks if infra is green. need to schedule an install window.
Sam (AE): renewal on this account is Q3 end — this expansion could move it to an easy renewal if we show cost savings vs their in-house. high priority.
Priya (Solutions): action: I'll draft a scaling proposal. need current token/sec baseline and peak multiplier. @Maria can you share the telemetry sample and request patterns?
Maria (CS): attaching sample in the follow-up thread. quick numbers from their dashboard: current steady ~6k tokens/sec, spikes ~18k for 10-15m.
Priya (Solutions): thanks. rough calc: that spike at 18k for 15m would need continuous concurrency changes. propose: 1) reserved dedicated pool for baseline 8k, 2) burst pool for spikes, 3) KV-prefix caching for repeated telemetry headings to cut token cost.
Operations Bot: deploy-plan created: PL-4823. Ops owner: @Liam.
Liam (Onboarding): I'll raise infra ticket with eng-sre for private VPC checklist and certs. estimate 3 business days to prep env once approved.
Sam (AE): flagged for legal — they might need SOC2 addendum for private infra.
Maria (CS): also capturing feedback: they want our console to show per-node latency breakdown (edge vs core). product asked to consider a lightweight dashboard widget.
Priya (Solutions): i'll include dashboard ask in the proposal.
Sam (AE): next steps: Priya to share draft proposal by EOD THU, Liam to open infra ticket today, Maria to coordinate sample payload + invite dev leads for kickoff next Tue.
Maria (CS): on it. thanks team :rocket:
Priya (Solutions): :thumbsup: will cc renewal lead once proposal is ready.
Liam (Onboarding): tagging eng-sre: @eng-sre, can someone validate capacity calc and suggest a staging window?
